name.zh: 推动整盘，让数字相遇合并
name.en: Slide the whole board to merge numbers

summary.zh: 一次方向输入会影响多排物件，不能只盯着眼前的一对。
summary.en: One directional input affects many pieces, so one attractive pair cannot be considered alone.

rules.zh: 玩家选择一个方向，让棋盘上的可移动物件一起滑动；满足配对条件的物件相遇后合并。有效移动还会加入新物件，因此每次腾出的空间也在被重新消耗，玩家必须维持整盘的可操作性。
rules.en: Choose a direction to slide every movable piece. Compatible pieces merge when they meet, and a successful move introduces a new piece. Reclaimed space is continually consumed, so the player must preserve useful movement across the whole board.

loop.en: Resolve merges and the incoming piece

loop.zh: 检查下一步仍能移动吗

decisions.zh: 合并眼前的大数字，是否会把小数字夹在角落无法配对？
decisions.en: Would merging a large pair trap small unmatched numbers in a corner?

decisions.zh: 要先腾出一格，还是维持整齐的数字顺序等待下一块？
decisions.en: Free a cell now or preserve an ordered arrangement for the next tile?

effect.zh: 滑到尽头变化大；只走一格更容易做细微调整，但新物件会更快挤占空间。
effect.en: Sliding to the edge changes more at once; one-cell movement allows finer adjustments while incoming pieces consume room.

effect.zh: 预告让玩家能安排入口；完全未知时需要保留更多通用空位。
effect.en: Preview supports planning around the entry; unknown pieces require more flexible free space.

implementation.zh: 方向键推动整盘，同数字相遇后合为更大数字；每次有效移动后出现新的低值方块。
implementation.en: Arrow-key input slides the board; equal values merge into a larger number and a valid move introduces a new low-value tile.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：数字方块分布在方形盘面中，旁边可见分数与操作按钮。
observation.en: System reference: Numbered tiles occupy a square board beside score information and controls. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 每次输入最多移动一格；1与2先合为3，此后相同的较大数字相合，并提供下一块的提示。
implementation.en: Each input moves tiles at most one cell; 1 and 2 combine into 3, then equal larger values combine, with a clue about the incoming tile.

cases.sourceLabel: Official Xbox game manual — indexed text

observation.zh: 系统参考图：官方说明图把数字方块与一加二得到三的规则并列展示。
observation.en: System reference: The official instructional image shows numbered tiles alongside the rule that one plus two makes three. See the linked text source for the rules.

cases.rights: Sirvo / Asher Vollmer / Greg Wohlwend / Jimmy Hinson

contrast.zh: 2048的整段滑动让一次操作大幅重排棋盘；Threes的一格移动和1、2配对规则，让入口与小数字管理更重要。
contrast.en: 2048 makes large board shifts per input; Threes emphasizes entry management and low-value pairing through one-cell movement and its 1-plus-2 rule.

combination.zh: 组合提案：把棋盘当搬运箱，相同零件合并后共用包装、减轻总重量。新货同时增加占位和重量，玩家要在更高等级与可搬走的负重之间取舍。
combination.en: Design proposal: treat the board as a shipping crate. Merging equal parts shares packaging and lowers weight, while incoming cargo adds both weight and occupied cells.

setup.zh: 一行从左到右是2、空、2、4，其余行也有数字。
setup.en: One row reads 2, empty, 2, 4, while other rows contain tiles too.

action.en: The player slides the board left.

result.zh: 这一行的两个2合成4，其他行也移动，随后加入新块。
result.en: The two 2s merge into a 4; other rows also shift, then a new tile enters.

next.zh: 玩家必须看整个棋盘，而不只是刚合成的4，选择下一次方向。
next.en: The next direction must account for the whole board rather than only the new 4.

firstStep.zh: 做四乘四数字棋盘，使用固定的新块序列，先比较四个方向的可读性。
firstStep.en: Build a four-by-four number board with a fixed incoming sequence to test the readability of all four directions.

pitfall.zh: 同一回合新合成的物件能否再次合并必须明确，否则预测和结算会不一致。
pitfall.en: Specify whether a newly merged tile can merge again that turn, or prediction and resolution will disagree.

test.zh: 玩家能否在输入前预测至少两排会如何变化？
test.en: Can players predict changes in at least two rows before an input?
